data.body: The new default means callers omitting these inputs run only Codex, but `docs/ai-developer-experience.md` still repeatedly says eligible pull requests automatically run both Claude and Codex. Users following that lifecycle guide will wait for Claude output that is never scheduled. Update its automatic-review and end-to-end descriptions, and qualify this document's introductory “both reviewers” wording, to reflect that Claude requires `run-claude: true`.
